items.title: Workspace header is wrong for resumed OpenCode sessions
items.reason: OpenCodeProvider.resumeSession ignores ResumeOptions.workingDirectory and uses the stored session.directory, so recording the requested workdir contradicts the Phase 2 gate (actual provider workspace on resume).
items.failure: A resumed OpenCode session from a different workdir or worktree logs the wrong workspace, so all targets are shortened against the wrong root or mislabeled as outside the workspace.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Record the session-reported effective workspace (optional AgentSession.workingDirectory set by OpenCodeSession from session.directory and by the CLI providers from their cwd); use the requested workdir only for fresh sessions; omit workspace when unknown on resume; add an OpenCode resume fixture whose directory differs from the request.

items.title: TUI signal handling ignores existing cli-lifecycle signal owner
items.reason: bin.ts installs cli-lifecycle, which aborts getCliAbortSignal and force-exits via process.exit(130/143) after a 2s grace or a second signal; the plan adds separate handlers and never mentions it, so TUI cleanup in finally can be bypassed and SIGTERM does not reach the watcher.
items.failure: A double SIGINT/SIGTERM, or cleanup stalled past the grace window, exits the process with the terminal left in raw mode on the alternate screen, violating the requirement that exceptional exits restore the terminal.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Merge getCliAbortSignal() into the controller abort, take the exit status from getCliAbortCause() (130/143), register a synchronous idempotent terminal restore on process exit while the UI is entered, and add PTY double-signal and grace-timeout cases.

items.title: Bounded rotating drain reorders legacy raw/human replay across files
items.reason: The 256-record/256 KiB drain budget and source rotation are unconditional changes to the shared NdjsonTailer; today poll() drains each file completely in sorted order. The existing small-fixture tests would not catch the change.
items.failure: Replaying two invocation backlogs over 256 records in --human-readable mode interleaves them in 256-record chunks with repeated label headers, breaking the existing output contract that requirements section 7 says must be kept.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Drain historical (pre-watermark) data in sorted file order to completion across turns; apply rotation only to live data or only under the TUI option; add a multi-file backlog of more than 256 records per file as a regression test for raw and human modes.

items.title: Paused viewport snapshot of rendered rows cannot survive resize
items.reason: Design Decisions stores bounded rendered rows while paused, but W6/W7 require resize to recompute layout while keeping selection and inspection; rows rendered for one width cannot be re-wrapped for another.
items.failure: Resizing from 140x40 to 40x6 while paused either overflows or clips the snapshot, or discards it and loses operator focus, failing the resize-preserves-focus acceptance criterion.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Snapshot bounded width-independent row models (stable IDs, sanitized text, inspector detail) under the existing 256 KiB cap and render them at the current size; add a pause-resize-restore controller test.

items.title: Phase 1 compiled/subprocess smoke has no entry point
items.reason: The Phase 1 gate requires source and compiled evidence for the adapter, but --tui is not exposed until Phase 6 and bun run build compiles only src/bin.ts.
items.failure: The Phase 1 compatibility gate cannot be checked as written, so renderer selection could be accepted without compiled-binary evidence.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Name a test-only fixture entry (for example test/fixtures/watch-terminal-smoke.ts) and the exact bun build --compile command used to produce the recorded evidence.

result_json.summary: Strong plan that covers requirements 208 and fixes the tailer's unbounded queue at the source. Four mechanical P1 corrections: resumed OpenCode workspace, integration with the cli-lifecycle signal owner, legacy replay ordering under bounded draining, and a resize-safe paused snapshot. One P2 gap in Phase 1 gate testability.

baselineAssessment.reason: W1/W3/W4/W5/W7 scores are plausible; W2 (public contract, three mappers incl. new Claude stream message/block tracking, workspace producer with resume correction) and W6 (controller, key surface, viewport model, CLI preflight, cli-lifecycle integration) are each about 2 points light.
